description.value: Grounds & Greens Cafe is a family-owned, fully plant-based cafe in downtown White Rock run by chefs Mannel and Ben Kilford, who bring over 35 years of combined culinary experience including time with Four Seasons Hotels. The menu centres on creative power bowls, artisan coffee, and house-made dishes using locally sourced ingredients, with a strong zero-waste ethos that eliminates single-use containers. A second location operates in Fort Langley, and the cafe is noted for being dog-friendly and welcoming to non-vegans.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully fetched and active, with a blog post dated November 2025 confirming the business is operating. The contact page corroborates the OSM address (1369 Johnston Rd, White Rock, BC V4B 3Z3) and phone number (604-531-0990). Takeout is explicitly confirmed ('Order for takeout or find us on DoorDash, Uber, & Skip The Dishes!'), the menu is 100% plant-based with multiple GF-labelled items, but no evidence of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible vegan cafe with a confirmed online presence and a November 2025 blog post; a useful stop for touring cyclists seeking plant-based food in White Rock.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Fully vegan/plant-based menu; multiple menu items explicitly labelled 'gf' (e.g. influencer, basic b***, the O.G.); website states 'gluten free bread available'

wow_evidence: A second location operates in Fort Langley
